summary: Sandbox acceptance completed 2026-10-23/24 with every check observed and passed on the tested pair: native Codex Desktop, Codex CLI and Claude Code consent, read, refresh and revoked-then-denied; refresh rotation and replay denial; revocation 401; shared limits; cross-user isolation; queued-job revocation; rolling worker; local stdio parity (19 tools); tool refresh; capacity at 5 req/s for 300 s with 10-way concurrency (REST p95 63 ms, hosted 110 ms) and database 85%, Redis 84%, worker 100% headroom. Publication was blocked only by a stray gitlink on app main, removed in the accepted app SHA with no runtime change. The accepted MCP runtime adds only owner-approved non-breaking security updates (zod, body-parser, fast-uri, ip-address, qs). The owner accepts this in place of a published evidence artifact.
